symptom: The live materializer completed model-side work but returned BLOCKED because the task-path serializer was invoked without the correct isolated candidate execution root; no candidate was published.

evidence.finalAssistantMessage: BLOCKED — o serializer falhou antes da validação candidata, pois não recebeu a raiz candidata correta. Nenhum artifact live foi publicado ou alterado; as árvores de staging foram removidas.

rootCause: Candidate staging and candidate-root transport remained model-authored mechanical work. The producer had a strict serializer, but no deterministic boundary allocated and returned the isolated complete candidate root, so the live invocation supplied an invalid or unavailable root to serialize-task-paths.mjs.
authorityImpact: None. Official state remained PLANNED_READY, live artifacts were not published, and candidate validation was not relaxed.
correction: Introduce a small deterministic materializer candidate-preparation boundary that resolves the official execution workspace, creates an external isolated candidate, copies the complete execution tree, and returns the exact candidate root before model-authored task content is written. The existing serializer and candidate validator remain strict.
regression: Add a behavior-level test proving the prepared candidate is external and isolated, contains the complete execution tree, preserves physical plan identity, and blocks invalid or non-canonical SPEC_PATH input.
